mathematics.conventions: Natural logarithm, L(x)=log(floor(x)!), Q_N={floor(N/d):2<=d<=N}; K is the last included zero-based lift level; R=6^(K+1)
inputs: N14 coefficients {1:1,2:-1,3:-3/2} and exact capped dual
non_claims: Finite checks do not prove the all-N lemma
The fixed leading excess remains linear
No uniform bound for psi(N)-N, RH conclusion, or novelty claim
